messages:
maria: Found a JSON SA key embedded in a partner onboarding tarball in gs://partner-onboard-uploads/onboard-20260321.tar.gz. File name inside: svc-bridge-prod-key.json. Not referenced in Vault.
lee: do we have any evidence it was used?
maria: partner pulled the tarball at 2026-03-21T09:58Z. I see no auth failures or suspicious calls in ourprod logs between 09:58-10:30, but we should treat it as compromised.
dan: creating incident and starting rotation playbook. Tagging @sre-oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260321-7 "partner archive SA key exposure". Priority=P1.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Immediate steps: 1) remove object from partner bucket (make it inaccessible), 2) revoke key, 3) issue new credential via secure channel, 4) scan backups for copies.
partner-ops: we downloaded the tarball, kept transient copy for onboarding but did not persist keys beyond process. We'll run retention confirm and share logs.
lee: We'll need to: rotate service account keys, audit IAM bindings for that service account (remove broad roles), rewrap any envelope keys that used this SA for encryption, capture audit logs to non-writable bucket for forensics.
maria: quick find: two older onboard archives (2025-12-*) also have references to svc-bridge in a readme and one contains a test key. Marked them for quarantine.
dan: commands I'm planning to run, lmk if anything missing:
```
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/new-bridge-key.json \\
  --iam-account=svc-bridge@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# revoke old key by key id (from list)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID \\
  --iam-account=svc-bridge@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
sre-oncall: Also enable temporary deny ACL on gs://partner-onboard-uploads for group partners: `gsutil iam ch group:partners:objectViewer` -> remove after sweep.
lee: We should also add a Vault policy to block read on path secret/onboard/partner/* for non-privileged groups for 48h and emit alerts for access attempts.
maria: KMS team: can you check if any archived blobs were encrypted with an envelope key that used that SA's credential? If yes, we'll need rewrap and coordinate with partner to update decrypt path.
kms-team-bot: Noted. We'll review key usage logs and report within 45m.
partner-ops: we've suspended the onboarding job and deleted the transient copy. We'll provide retention logs and contact info for the operator who pulled it.
dan: scan running across all buckets (regex: "private_key"|svc-bridge|BEGIN PRIVATE KEY) to find other leaks.
sre-oncall: Found 3 matches in gs://backups/onboard/2025-12-05.tar.gz, gs://backups/onboard/2025-12-12.tar.gz, and gs://staging-uploads/quickstart.tar.gz. Quarantining those objects and exporting them to gs://redwood-sec-evidence-readonly for forensic team.
lee: Good. Make sure export bucket has object-level immutability and restricted access.
maria: Partner confirmed they called the ingestion endpoint one time with the pulled archive; no successful authenticated calls observed. Still rotating.
dan: After rotation, flip services to use Workload Identity or short-lived keys and file infra ticket to remove long-lived JSON keys from onboarding artifacts.
lee: I'm applying minimal IAM roles for svc-bridge: roles/storage.objectViewer on specific buckets and roles/pubsub.publisher on specific topics only. Removing any project-level editor/owner bindings.
partner-ops: will accept new key via our secure vault endpoint once you provide it. We'll confirm after smoke test.
sre-oncall: started deletion/quarantine of matched objects at 2026-03-21T10:12Z. Logging actions to incident.
incident-bot: INC-20260321-7 updated: state=mitigating, owners=[maria,lee,dan,sre-oncall,kms-team].
maria: Reminder: export Cloud Audit Logs (admin activity + data access) for the onboarding project to readonly bucket before any deletion. Doing that now.
lee: Also add an automated CI gate: onboarding artifact CI job should fail if it contains files matching regex for JSON keys or `private_key`. I'll open PR to add check to onboarding pipeline.
dan: For postmortem: recommend ramping retention alerts for partner buckets (s3/gs) to flag archives containing suspected credentials and add RBAC to prevent group-level broad read.
sre-oncall: I'm running continuous scan for 24h to ensure no other exposures surface. Will also watch for anomalous token usage.
maria: thanks all. I'll attach partner convo, evidence, and timelines to the incident and schedule a 30m post-incident review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
